title: HAUSPROFI Double Sleeping Mat for Camping — Inflatable, for 2 People, with Foot Pump & Pillow
short_description: Inflatable double sleeping mat by HAUSPROFI for 2 people with an integrated foot pump and pillow. Waterproof 40D nylon with TPU coating — for camping, hiking and the beach.
long_description: The HAUSPROFI double sleeping mat is an inflatable camping air mattress for 2 people in the Blue-double version. A foot pump is built in, and a pillow is included. According to the Amazon listing the material is 40D nylon with a waterproof TPU coating and the maximum load is up to 300 kg. According to Amazon the package includes a storage bag, a repair kit with 4 pieces and an instruction manual. Please check the exact dimensions and scope of delivery on the Amazon product page before buying.
buying_angle: Useful for couples and campers who want to sleep on one inflatable mat with a built-in foot pump and pillow in the tent.
